university.name: Regent's University London
university.summary: Regent's University London is in London. Its international students page states that all students pay the same tuition fees regardless of nationality and that applications can be made directly at any time of year. Pakistan has its own entry requirements page.
university.eligibility_note: International students page describes the CAS and visa process; a sponsor licence statement was not found on the pages opened and the gov.uk register file was not opened

courses.title: Business and Management
courses.overview: Three-year full-time business degree with core modules in leadership, finance, operations and strategy, two major project modules in Year 3, and an optional study abroad term in Year 2. An optional integrated foundation year is available.
highlights: Year 1 core: Self Leadership and Leading Others; Money, Finance and Decisions
Year 2 core: Managing Performance and Innovation; Sustainable Operations
Year 3 core: Disruptive Strategies and Models; Major Project I and II
Electives in each year; study abroad term in Year 2 is optional
courses.academic_requirements: One of: three GCE A-levels at grade A to C; 24 points in the International Baccalaureate; US High School Diploma with minimum GPA 2.5 plus specified AP, SAT, ACT or college credit results; or equivalent qualifications accepted by the University and UK ENIC.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall and 5.5 in each component (or GCSE English language C (4), IB English, or US HSD English equivalents). Home or online editions of English tests are not accepted. Pakistan page: SELT such as IELTS with 6.0 overall and no less than 5.5 in each category.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, undergraduate: "Two-year Bachelor's degree with minimum 40%", personal statement 300 to 500 words. The wording differs from the course page A-level route, so confirm which Pakistani qualifications are accepted for Year 1 entry. Foundation route: Higher School Certificate (Year 12) with a minimum grade average of 60%.
courses.career_notes: Page lists graduate roles across banking, PR, fashion and TV, and mentions eligibility for a Graduate visa of up to 18 months.
courses.uk_min_alevels: Three A levels, grades A to C
courses.application_deadline_note: No fixed deadline; direct applications accepted year-round
courses.notes: Fee shown is for September 2026 or January 2027 start; September 2027 fees are stated as under review (target year fee not yet published). Regent's states one fee for all nationalities. PTE 64 (no skill below 59) from the general English requirements page; TOEFL and Duolingo scores exist on that page but Pakistan applicants are told to take a SELT, so left null. Advance deposit for non-UK students GBP 5,000.

courses.title: Law
courses.overview: Three-year full-time law degree with core modules in contract, tort, criminal, public, land and business law, plus electives and an industry and entrepreneurship strand. An optional study abroad term is available in Year 2.
highlights: Year 1 core: Legal Rules and Systems; Contract Law; Criminal Law and Evidence
Year 2 core: Land, Equity and Trusts; Tort Law
Year 3 core: Business Law and Ethics; Major Project I and II
Electives in each year; Year 2 study abroad term is optional
courses.academic_requirements: One of: three A-levels at BCC; 26 International Baccalaureate points; US High School Diploma with minimum GPA 2.7 plus specified AP, SAT, ACT or college credit results; or equivalent qualifications accepted by the University and UK ENIC.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall and 5.5 in each component (or GCSE English language C (4), IB English, or US HSD English equivalents). Home or online editions of English tests are not accepted. Pakistan page: SELT such as IELTS with 6.0 overall and no less than 5.5 in each category.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, undergraduate: "Two-year Bachelor's degree with minimum 40%", personal statement 300 to 500 words. The wording differs from the course page A-level route, so confirm which Pakistani qualifications are accepted for Year 1 entry.
courses.career_notes: Page lists roles including private practice lawyer, in-house legal counsel, compliance officer and legal technologist, and mentions Graduate visa eligibility of up to 18 months.
courses.application_deadline_note: No fixed deadline; direct applications accepted year-round
courses.notes: Page overview says the course accepts Year One applicants for September 2026, which conflicts with later start dates listed (January 2027, September 2027). Fee is for September 2026 or January 2027 start; September 2027 fees under review. Recognition of the LLB for legal practice is not stated on the page.

courses.title: Project Management
courses.duration_text: 12 to 16 months (September starts run 12 months; January starts run 16 months)
courses.overview: Full-time master's covering project management practice, leadership and change, and tools and techniques, with a final major project in the last term. Language or special elective modules are taken in the first two terms.
highlights: Global Issues in Complex Project Management
Cultivating Project Management Leadership and Change
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum second-class UK undergraduate degree, or an equivalent international qualification acceptable to Admissions and UK ENIC. Applicants without a degree may apply through exceptional entry with three years of work experience.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with 5.5 or above in each component. Home or online editions of English tests are not accepted.
courses.experience_requirements: Only for exceptional entry without a degree: three years of work experience, CV, employment and reference letters, personal statement.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, postgraduate: "Four-year Bachelor's degree from Pakistan with minimum First division (60%, grade A/B, CGPA 2.75)"; English SELT such as IELTS 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in each category; personal statement 500 to 700 words. CGPA scale is not stated on the page.
courses.career_notes: Page lists roles such as Project Manager, Programme Manager, Risk Manager and Business Analyst, and mentions Graduate visa eligibility of up to 18 months.
courses.application_deadline_note: No fixed deadline stated on the course page
courses.notes: Fee is for September 2026 or January 2027 start; September 2027 fees under review. PTE 67 is the postgraduate overall score from the general English requirements page (component wording on that page was unclear). Minimum UK degree class stated only as second class.

courses.title: Finance and Financial Technology
courses.overview: Full-time master's combining financial technology, investments, corporate finance and econometrics, concluding with a dissertation. The page also lists optional additional qualifications such as a Certificate in Quantitative Finance.
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum second-class UK undergraduate degree, or an equivalent international qualification acceptable to Admissions and UK ENIC. Applicants without a degree may apply through exceptional entry with three years of work experience.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic overall 6.5 with 5.5 or above in each component. Home or online editions of English tests are not accepted.
courses.experience_requirements: Only for exceptional entry without a degree: three years of work experience, CV, employment and reference letters, personal statement.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan page, postgraduate: "Four-year Bachelor's degree from Pakistan with minimum First division (60%, grade A/B, CGPA 2.75)"; English SELT such as IELTS 6.5 overall and no less than 5.5 in each category; personal statement 500 to 700 words. CGPA scale is not stated on the page.
courses.career_notes: Page lists work in commercial banking, fintech, asset trading, financial research and digital transformation, and mentions Graduate visa eligibility of up to 18 months.
courses.application_deadline_note: No fixed deadline stated on the course page
courses.notes: Fee is for September 2026 or January 2027 start; September 2027 fees under review. Minimum UK degree class stated only as second class. Page also lists September 2026 as a start.

scholarships.name: UG Global Scholarship, January 2027
scholarships.value_text: Varies from GBP 1,000 to GBP 4,000 off first-year tuition fees
scholarships.summary: Fee reduction on first-year tuition for new full-time undergraduate students, including foundation, starting in January 2027. Reviewed automatically on application, with the deposit due within 14 days of confirmation.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer for a full-time undergraduate degree (or with foundation) starting January 2027; pay the deposit within 14 days of scholarship confirmation; new students only; cannot be deferred or combined with another scholarship or offer.
scholarships.deadline_note: No fixed closing date; early application recommended
scholarships.notes: September 2027 version not yet published. The September 2026 page carried the same value range.

scholarships.name: PG Global Scholarship, January 2027
scholarships.value_text: Varies from GBP 1,000 to GBP 4,000 off tuition fees
scholarships.summary: Fee reduction for new full-time postgraduate students starting in January 2027, excluding a short list of courses. Reviewed automatically on application, with the deposit due within 14 days of confirmation.
scholarships.criteria_text: Hold an offer for a full-time postgraduate degree starting January 2027; pay the deposit within 14 days of scholarship confirmation; new students only; cannot be deferred or combined with another scholarship or offer. Excludes MA Luxury Hospitality Management, MProf Psychotherapy and the Psychotherapy and Counselling certificates.
scholarships.deadline_note: No fixed closing date; early application recommended
scholarships.notes: Page does not say whether the reduction applies to first year only. September 2027 version not yet published.

scholarships.name: Alumni Advantage Award
scholarships.summary: Tuition reduction for Regent's alumni, including Study Abroad students, who progress to a postgraduate course. Applicants must have completed an undergraduate course or a Study Abroad period at Regent's.
scholarships.criteria_text: Regent's alumni (including Study Abroad students) holding an offer for a postgraduate course starting September 2026 or January 2027; submit the scholarship application form with undergraduate degree details and student number. Two psychotherapy progression routes are excluded.
scholarships.notes: Page names September 2026 and January 2027 intakes only; September 2027 terms not published.
